syncSegmentsEn.text: Praise flows from the heart
From a heart that simply loves the Lord
I sing praise for the Lord alone
Praise from the heart rings out for the Lord alone
Joy dwells deep in my heart
The joy that comes from the Lord lifts my heart in gladness
My heart no longer wanders in confusion
The life that comes from the Lord is full of fragrance
I will proclaim aloud and sing with all my heart
The loving Lord is my King forever

My love for the Lord grows stronger day by day
